## Question 1

Laura is making a budget with Python. She has a part-time job which she works 10 days per month; she makes £100 on each of those days.

She wants to make a variable store this information. Her variable `income_part_time` should have the result of multiplying 10 by 100. But she is getting an error message.

Can you fix it?

```{python}
# Fix Laura's variable.
income_part_time = 10 x 100

# Show the value of `income_part_time`.
income_part_time
```

### Run the next cell to mark your answer.

                       quick_check_1()[1])
